findings.title: Silence action shown for Prometheus-only Grafana rules cannot open a drawer
findings.body: The new list passes only `promRule` to this component. `AlertRuleMenu` now correctly enables and renders “Silence notifications” using the Prometheus-rule ability, but clicking it only sets `showSilenceDrawer`; the drawer is still rendered only when a ruler alerting rule exists. Consequently the menu item is a no-op for every Grafana rule rendered by `GrafanaRuleListItem`.

findings.title: Delete is unavailable for Grafana rules after removing ruler data from the list
findings.body: For the new Prometheus-only Grafana list items, `canDelete` can be true from `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, but the Delete menu item is additionally gated on `rulerRule`. Since `GrafanaRuleListItem` never supplies a ruler rule, users with delete permission cannot delete Grafana-managed rules from either the filtered list or group list. The supplied delete handler already closes over the identifier, so this condition prevents an otherwise supported action.

findings.title: Pause is unavailable for Prometheus-only Grafana list entries
findings.body: The menu computes `canPause` using the new Grafana Prometheus ability, but only renders `MenuItemPauseRule` when a Grafana ruler rule is present. The new list deliberately supplies no ruler rule, so pausing/unpausing Grafana-managed rules disappears from the list even for authorized users. This leaves the newly added Prometheus pause permission path unusable.

findings.title: Federated rules lose their immutability protection
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` previously detected federated rule groups from `CombinedRule.group` and treated them as immutable. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, where federation is hard-coded to false because only a group identifier is available. Existing consumers of `useAlertRuleAbility`/`useAlertRuleAbilities` can therefore expose update, delete, pause, restore, and permanent-delete controls for federated external rules that were intentionally protected before this change.

findings.title: Grafana rule links no longer preserve the originating list URL
findings.body: The former Grafana list item added `createReturnTo()` to its view URL. The replacement constructs a bare `/alerting/grafana/<uid>/view` URL, so opening a rule from a filtered or paginated rule list no longer provides the detail page with the originating location. The detail page’s return navigation will fall back to its default list instead of restoring the user’s filters/context.
